Definition: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
BiblicalUsage: 1) to save, be saved, be delivered; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be liberated, be saved, be delivered; 1a2) to be saved (in battle), be victorious; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to save, deliver; 1b2) to save from moral troubles; 1b3) to give victory to
